levie.en:
Personal assistant agents are going to be a very exciting AI category. It’s the first time you can have high token volume agentic use-cases that make sense for consumers. 

Lots of different approaches emerging right now, and it’s going to be hyper competitive because these agents will mediate a lot of consumer spend over time. 

But this certainly plays directly to Meta’s strengths: lots of compute required, can monetize with ads and commerce, software focused experiences so can distribute it at scale, and so on.

adityaag.en:
It's a weird time.

As many of you know, my superpower is optimism. I have an insane ability to look at any situation through the most positive lens. I strongly believe that today is the "least best" (not worst) day of my life and tomorrow will be glorious.

I am super optimistic about where AI is going.

But I also find myself genuinely anxious about the pace of change and our inability to understand how these (insanely) complicated machines work.

I always err on the side of "just let us cook". The only way out is through. Let us build. 

But man, it is a weird time.
